mapper.select: SELECT upload_file_id, target_type, target_id, org_file_nm, real_file_nm, file_size, del_yn, reg_dt FROM upload_file ORDER BY upload_file_id DESC

SELECT upload_file_id, target_type, target_id, org_file_nm, real_file_nm, file_size, del_yn, reg_dt FROM upload_file WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY upload_file_id ASC
SELECT upload_file_id, target_type, target_id, org_file_nm, real_file_nm, file_size, del_yn, reg_dt FROM upload_file WHERE upload_file_id = #{uploadFileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_file (target_type, target_id, org_file_nm, real_file_nm, file_size, del_yn, reg_dt) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{orgFileNm}, #{realFileNm}, #{fileSize}, 'N', NOW())
